asr.full_text: Welcome to Airtel Navaswani's Video Ma'am the market is neither looking towards USA nor going towards Iran The focus of the market is on this that from this point when the supply of oil from O2 will be regular because if the oil itself remains to be elevated then our macro will disturb A report from Kotak has come, saying that the cost of petrol and diesel should also increase from Rs 25 to Rs 28 after the election is over Ma'am what are your sense? in politics and elections. So, it is a different matter how much they will want it to be high. And as far as Geo… You are saying that there is no discussion of war and geopolitics, but a year ago, a month ago, when I came to your channel, this was the main thing, and I had said that you should not react too much to geopolitics. Look at your portfolio and your allocation. The data of 125 years says that except for countries that are directly in that war, there is no lasting effect in the stock market except for those directly in that war. But you will have to see company by company if someone is dependent on crude or petrochemicals, then what will be the margin of that company from there, you will have to see such things. Devina ma'am, what was the conversation in America? In America, we are see that people are worried. Donald Trump's policies are being opposed. If we talk about gasoline prices, then the price of petrol has increased by 20-25% and in California, the prices have doubled. But the sentiment of the stock market is different because there is a new record of S&P 500, Mastic is making a new record. If we look at Asia, then here in the markets of Japan or Korea, So why are the sentiment and price of Indian market so decoupled? As I said, the S&P has been increasing but now the composition that has increased is completely different What I often read in newspapers or on TV The so-called experts say that There is no money coming from India because there are no AI companies If you say it in a more fancy way India does not have an innovation story The bullies of India are there forever, but that is now ending. But some say that we often drive while looking back. So, till now, the stories are the same, that there is no AI in India, and that is not the reason. But, your point is right, that India has not only lacked America, but also the emerging markets. So, you can say that this is a matter of concern, but in a way, it is also that, I said that the range is around the bottom, I don't know if it will go from the bottom after a week, two weeks, two months, but that thing has almost been fixed. The market has also become more broad-based here. It's not like last year, where your index was showing positive but median stock was down and you were seeing red marks in the portfolio. Correct. I was going to ask you the same thing. It is good that you touched upon it. Because last year, Nifty had made a return of around 10 Nifty, but there was no money in the broader market. Now the picture is changing, and if you look at the year to date Nifty, it is 7% down and if we look at the small cap 100, then it is almost flat with a slight gain. So there is a little difficulty that when there is uncertainty, when there is a crisis, then money comes out of small cap. Here it is going the other way round. Money is coming in the small cap and mid cap, and it is coming out of large cap. So, how do you make strategies in the market? See, as per the small cap and mid cap, it is not completely correct to see it because there are many sectors and many types of companies in all sectors. But let me tell you that because of the definition of large cap, mid cap and small cap, there is no market cap cut-off. Actually, there are a lot of cut-offs. When I saw the small cap cut-off, it was close to 30,000 crores market cap, which is not actually a small cap. So, in that, and in the mid-cap, you can say that there are many big companies. So, that is not in that context, but this is your point, I also said the same at the end that now the breadth of the market is increasing. Last year, now BSE 500 was also some 5-1% up, but the median stock was down. 57% stocks were down, 40% were down, and 10% were down. So now the situation has changed to some extent. In the middle, the large cap was fixed, and it doesn't work very often, but now the market is improving and the market is improving. All the signs are good for the market. Yes, okay. Divina ma'am Thank you very much for taking your time and sharing your thoughts on some important issues with us. Thank you so much ma'am for giving us time today. It is time to end the show. The fall of Nifty is almost reached its 100th number. A good recovery has come from the lower level. Nifty bank is below 350. We will discuss midcap small cap in detail in midcap masala. I will see you in the next video. Namaskar.
